name: Manmunai Bridge
connectingPointsDisplay: Western shore of Batticaloa lagoon — Eastern shore of Batticaloa lagoon
facts: Manmunai Bridge, the first east–west land link across Batticaloa Lagoon, slashed the previous 30‑kilometre detour, instantly connecting the town to the mainland and Ampara District.
Constructed with a 1,206‑million‑yen grant from the Japan International Cooperation Agency, the bridge marks sixty years of Sri Lanka–Japan diplomatic friendship.
Before the bridge, commuters relied on a small ferry across the lagoon; Manmunai Bridge replaced that fragile link with a durable, all‑weather roadway.
